```{python}
#| label: fig-trx-fd-circulator
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Block diagram of an in-band full-duplex (FD) RF front-end using a single antenna and a circulator. The circulator routes TX to the antenna and the antenna to RX, while isolating the TX from the RX port."
import schemdraw as sd
import schemdraw.elements as elm
import schemdraw.dsp as dsp

sd.svgconfig.svg2 = False

with sd.Drawing(canvas='svg') as d:
    d.config(unit=2, fontsize=14, margin=0.5)

    # The circulator routes TX -> antenna -> RX.
    circ = dsp.Circulator()

    # Shared antenna on the circulator W port
    dsp.Line().left(d.unit/2).at(circ.W)
    elm.Antenna()

    # RX path on top (antenna -> RX)
    dsp.Line().up(d.unit/2).at(circ.N)
    dsp.Arrow().right(d.unit/2).label(r'RX')
    dsp.Amp()
    dsp.Arrow().right(d.unit/2).linestyle('--').label(r'$s_\mathrm{RX}$', 'right')

    # TX path on bottom (TX -> antenna)
    dsp.Arrow().down(d.unit/2).at(circ.S).reverse()
    dsp.Line().right(d.unit/2).label(r'TX')
    dsp.Amp().reverse()
    dsp.Arrow().right(d.unit/2).reverse().linestyle('--').label(r'$s_\mathrm{TX}$', 'right')
```
